title.zh: 序列化和反序列化二叉树

desc.zh: 用前序与空标记保留二叉树的完整形状。
desc.en: Preserve a binary tree's full shape with preorder and null markers.

complexity: O(n) time; O(n) explicit stack plus O(n) input/output storage

concepts.name: preorder with null markers
concepts.description: Values alone collide (1,2,3,4,5 fits two trees); recording every empty child with # fixes the shape.

concepts.name: open-slot stack
concepts.description: The pending stack lists the child positions the recursive decoder still owes; each token fills the top one.

concepts.name: subtree decoding invariant
concepts.description: Which position each token fills is fixed by the tokens before it, so one string decodes to one tree.
